data.title: About George
bio: George is a third generation realtor following in his family's footsteps.  Born into a family of realtors George grew up watching and learning from his grandfather and parents who have nearly 100 years of experience as agents in New Jersey.  Now partners with his mother Denise Meyers a Realtor of more than 25 year.

Raised in Monroe Township George has a strong background and knowledge of the real estate market in Middlesex County.  Monroe Township school teacher and coach with a dedication to the pursuit of lifelong continued education.  George lives in Bordentown NJ with his soon to be wife Kait and loveable dog Riley.

Sales Associate with a passion for all things real estate related.  If you are looking for a hungry new agent motivated to help you achieve all of your real estate goals look no further then George Meyers.
